title: Peripheral Nervous System | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: A rather low power magnification of autonomic ganglion cells. Note the eccentric nuclei and the irregularly shaped cell bodies. These cells are efferent (motor) cells of the autonomic nervous system. Note the relatively sparse satellite cells in this image, and the open space surrounding the ganglion cells. UCLA Histology Collection.

title: Peripheral Nervous System | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: This is a sympathetic ganglion but all autonomic ganglias will have similar characteristics. The neuronal cell bodies are multipolar with a large eccentric nucleus. Satellite cell nuclei are distributed between the neurons but are often separated from the neurons by a space. This space is the location of pre-ganglionic synapses onto the post-ganglionic autonomic cell bodies of the ganglion. Compare the appearance of this slide with a sensory (DRG [N13-40-1] or trigeminal ganglion. UCLA Histology Collection.
